description: This Java file defines an Android Activity called TranslucentGLSurfaceViewActivity that demonstrates the use of GLSurfaceView for rendering translucent 3D graphics with specific EGL configuration and surface format settings.

classes.name: TranslucentGLSurfaceViewActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating how to set up a GLSurfaceView with a translucent pixel format and a custom renderer for transparent 3D rendering.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GLSurfaceView, configures it for translucency, assigns a renderer, and sets it as the activity's content view.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume lifecycle, resumes rendering on the GLSurfaceView.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles activity pause lifecycle, pauses rendering on the GLSurfaceView.
